subject: Genetics
title: Yamanaka Factors
description: Learn Yamanaka Factors in one minute.

hook.text: In 2006, Shinya Yamanaka turned adult skin cells back into stem cells using just four genes. He reversed cellular aging.

buildup.text: Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc can reprogram the epigenome, erasing adult marks and restoring pluripotency.

discovery.text: Induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) have reset epigenomes.

twist.text: Full reprogramming creates cancer risk—c-Myc is an oncogene.

climax.text: Altos Labs, backed by billions, bets partial reprogramming can reverse aging in living organisms.

punchline.text: Four genes rewrite the epigenome. Aging reversed.

quiz.question: What do Yamanaka factors do?
options: Reprogram adult cells back to a stem-cell state
